title: New ransomware campaign targeting cloud infrastructure
description: Security researchers have identified a new ransomware variant specifically designed to target cloud-based infrastructure. The campaign uses compromised CI/CD pipelines to deploy malicious code.

title: Show HN: Open-source vulnerability scanner
description: New tool automatically scans dependencies for known vulnerabilities and suggests patches. Gaining traction in the security community.

title: A weakness has been identified in Oray Pugongying X5 Pro up to 7.6.1. Affected by this...
description: A weakness has been identified in Oray Pugongying X5 Pro up to 7.6.1. Affected by this vulnerability is the function config_restore_ex of the file /etc/openwrt_release. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

title: HTTP::Session versions before 0.54 for Perl allow memcached command injection via unfiltered...
description:
HTTP::Session versions before 0.54 for Perl allow memcached command injection via unfiltered session ids in HTTP::Session::Store::CHI.

description: A security vulnerability has been detected in Hangzhou Xiongmai Technology P2PAPI.dll 1.3.3.32 on Windows. Affected by this issue is the function P2PAPI_Connect of the component P2P SDK. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

title: A flaw has been found in Typemill up to 2.26.0. The impacted element is the function...
description: A flaw has been found in Typemill up to 2.26.0. The impacted element is the function ControllerApiImage::saveImage of the file system/typemill/Models/SvgSanitizer.php. Executing a manipulation can lead to cross site scripting. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.27.0 is sufficient to resolve this issue. This patch is called 9ca43c4a7b6764c5a6ac11a2ccc099b036ee3cef. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

title: The MapPress  WordPress plugin before 2.97.15 does not restrict which user's data its front-end...
description: The MapPress  WordPress plugin before 2.97.15 does not restrict which user's data its front-end map embed handler renders, allowing unauthenticated visitors to retrieve the email address and display name of any user on the site by enumerating user IDs.

title: The Kali Forms — Contact Form & Drag-and-Drop Builder WordPress plugin before 2.4.30 does not...
description: The Kali Forms — Contact Form & Drag-and-Drop Builder WordPress plugin before 2.4.30 does not perform a capability check on its test-email handler, relying only on a nonce that is available to any logged-in user, so a low-privileged user such as a Subscriber can make the site send email to an arbitrary recipient with a spoofed sender address.

title: The Media Library Assistant WordPress plugin before 3.44 does not check that the requesting user...
description: The Media Library Assistant WordPress plugin before 3.44 does not check that the requesting user is allowed to view a post before disclosing which taxonomy terms are assigned to it, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to learn the term assignments of private attachments and posts.

title: The Kali Forms — Contact Form & Drag-and-Drop Builder WordPress plugin before 2.4.30 does not...
description: The Kali Forms — Contact Form & Drag-and-Drop Builder WordPress plugin before 2.4.30 does not perform a capability check when its test-email handler resolves and returns a user's email address, relying only on a nonce that is available to any logged-in user, allowing authenticated users with minimal privileges (Subscriber and above) to disclose the email address of any registered user, including administrators.

title: The Media Library Assistant WordPress plugin before 3.44 does not escape one of its shortcode...
description: The Media Library Assistant WordPress plugin before 3.44 does not escape one of its shortcode attributes before outputting it in an attribute of generated links, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks.

title: imagecodecs 2023.1.23 through 2026.10.10 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in...
description: imagecodecs 2023.1.23 through 2026.10.10 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the lossless JPEG Define Huffman Table parser in decode_jpegsof3(). Attackers can supply a crafted lossless JPEG whose DHT symbol counts wrap an 8-bit sum, overflowing the 32-entry HufVal and HufSz stack arrays and crashing the calling process.

title: imagecodecs 2026.3.6 through 2026.10.10 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in...
description: imagecodecs 2026.3.6 through 2026.10.10 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in ccitt_fax4_decode_size() that allows attackers to hang the calling process by supplying a crafted CCITT Group 4 stream. Attackers can provide an 8-byte G4 stream lacking EOFB to ccittfax4_decode() or the numcodecs Ccittfax4 codec, consuming full CPU until the process is killed.

title: Thelia Back-office Default Twig Template before 1.1.1 contains a cross-site request forgery...
description: Thelia Back-office Default Twig Template before 1.1.1 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the /admin/product/combinations/update and /admin/product/default-price/update routes, which accept GET requests without anti-CSRF token checks. Attackers can lure a logged-in administrator into following a crafted link to rewrite product combination prices, stock, weight, EAN and sale flags, zeroing omitted prices.

title: OpenAlgo 1.0.0.29 before 2.0.3.1 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in...
description: OpenAlgo 1.0.0.29 before 2.0.3.1 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in utils/email_utils.py and utils/email_debug.py that disables TLS hostname and certificate checks for STARTTLS and SMTPS. Network-positioned attackers can present a forged certificate to intercept SMTP credentials and all later mail, including password-reset links.

title: CVE-2026-114741 - The WPVR  WordPress plugin before 9.0.3 does not perform object-level authorization checks when read
description: The WPVR  WordPress plugin before 9.0.3 does not perform object-level authorization checks when reading and updating virtual tours, allowing users with contributor-level access and above to read and modify tours created by other users.

title: CVE-2026-114740 - The WPVR  WordPress plugin before 9.1.3 does not correctly check user capabilities when creating a t
description: The WPVR  WordPress plugin before 9.1.3 does not correctly check user capabilities when creating a tour through its setup wizard, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to create and publish tour content and set arbitrary post metadata they could not otherwise create or publish.

title: CVE-2026-111981 - The GiveWP  WordPress plugin before 4.19.0.1 does not perform a capability check when handling donor
description: The GiveWP  WordPress plugin before 4.19.0.1 does not perform a capability check when handling donor address changes, allowing users who have been granted donor-report (view) access but not donor-edit access to add, modify, or delete the stored address of any donor on the site.

title: CVE-2026-111980 - The GiveWP  WordPress plugin before 4.19.0.1 does not correctly determine which page a page-capabili
description: The GiveWP  WordPress plugin before 4.19.0.1 does not correctly determine which page a page-capability request applies to, allowing users with a custom fundraising role to edit, publish and read pages owned by other users, including administrators.

title: CVE-2026-111979 - The GiveWP  WordPress plugin before 4.19.0.1 does not properly sanitise and escape one of its donati
description: The GiveWP  WordPress plugin before 4.19.0.1 does not properly sanitise and escape one of its donation form template settings before outputting it inside an HTML attribute, allowing users with a custom form-editing GiveWP  WordPress plugin before 4.19.0.1 role to inject arbitrary web scripts that execute in the browser of any visitor or administrator who opens the affected donation form.

title: CVE-2026-111978 - The GiveWP  WordPress plugin before 4.19.0.1 does not properly validate a user-supplied filename bef
description: The GiveWP  WordPress plugin before 4.19.0.1 does not properly validate a user-supplied filename before reading it from disk, allowing users with a high-privilege custom role to perform path traversal, disclose the contents of JSON-parseable files anywhere on the server, and overwrite the GiveWP  WordPress plugin before 4.19.0.1's stored configuration.

title: CVE-2026-111976 - The GiveWP  WordPress plugin before 4.19.0.1 does not perform any status or capability check when re
description: The GiveWP  WordPress plugin before 4.19.0.1 does not perform any status or capability check when rendering a donation form on a public front-end route, allowing unauthenticated visitors to view the content and settings of unpublished (draft, pending, private and scheduled) donation forms that WordPress core otherwise keeps non-public.

title: CVE-2026-110285 - The WP Stripe Checkout WordPress plugin before 1.2.2.62 does not verify the Stripe webhook signature
description: The WP Stripe Checkout WordPress plugin before 1.2.2.62 does not verify the Stripe webhook signature when no signing secret is configured, which is its default state, allowing unauthenticated attackers to forge a payment completion notification and create a completed order without paying.

title: CVE-2025-15705 - The Contact Form by Supsystic  WordPress plugin before 1.8.0 does not sanitise and escape a form nam
description: The Contact Form by Supsystic  WordPress plugin before 1.8.0 does not sanitise and escape a form name, allowing users with access to the form editor to inject arbitrary web scripts that execute when another user views the form. On multisite installations, where administrators do not hold the unfiltered_html capability, this crosses a privilege boundary.

title: CVE-2026-115999 - A vulnerability has been found in mansi-k Restaurant_IMS d7ad49f61ab7cc1ec6eb359ac2b5378bdbde0694. A
description: A vulnerability has been found in mansi-k Restaurant_IMS d7ad49f61ab7cc1ec6eb359ac2b5378bdbde0694. Affected is the function mysqli_connect of the file lsmodal.php. The manipulation of the argument login_id/epsw leads to sql injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. title: CVE-2026-115997 - A flaw has been found in pig-mesh pig up to 4.1.0. This impacts the function orderItem.getColumn of
description: A flaw has been found in pig-mesh pig up to 4.1.0. This impacts the function orderItem.getColumn of the file pig-common/pig-common-data/src/main/java/com/pig4cloud/pig/common/data/resolver/SqlFilterArgumentResolver.java. Executing a manipulation of the argument ascs/descs can lead to sql injection. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 4.1.1 will fix this issue. This patch is called 9b6311161e346d7626c81d993044072fed2dca07. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.
